title: US-Israel-Iran War Live: Israel launches fresh attack on Tehran; toll rises to 570 in Lebanon
desc: US-Israel-Iran War Live Updates: The conflict between Iran and the joint front of Israel and the United States entered its 12th day on Wednesday, with fresh Iranian missile attacks targeting central Israel before dawn as air raid sirens sounded and Israeli air defences intercepted incoming rockets. Iranian state media also reported new strikes on US military installations in Bahrain early Wednesday, following a wave of Iranian missile and drone attacks late Tuesday on bases linked to the US in Qatar, Iraq’s Kurdistan, the UAE and Bahrain. The escalation comes after intense US and Israeli airstrikes on Iran on Tuesday, described by the Pentagon and witnesses as among the heaviest of the war so far. Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps warned it could block oil shipments from the Gulf unless the attacks stop, raising fears of disruption to global energy supplies. Meanwhile, the White House reiterated US President Donald Trump’s warning of severe retaliation if Iran attempts to halt shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, even as he said US forces had destroyed 10 Iranian 'inactive' mine-laying vessels in recent strikes. Follow IndiaToday.in for live updates on the Middle East war.
